glosses.notes: 配送 is used for sending goods to a person or place, especially as part of a delivery service.

examples.sentence: 公司说今天下午会把电脑配送到家。
搬新家那天，我们让公司直接配送床和桌子。
爷爷住院以后，药店每天都会配送药过去。

example_translations.translation: The company said it would deliver the computer to our home this afternoon.
On the day we moved into the new place, we had the company deliver the bed and table directly.
After Grandpa was hospitalized, the pharmacy delivered medicine there every day.

glosses.notes: 盆 can mean a basin or tub, and it is also used for a flowerpot or other round container.

examples.sentence: 洗完菜以后，她把水倒进旁边的大盆里。
阳台上那盆花几天没浇水，叶子都软了。
医生让他先把脚放进那盆热水里。

example_translations.translation: After washing the vegetables, she poured the water into the large basin beside her.
The potted flower on the balcony had not been watered for several days, and its leaves had gone soft.
The doctor told him to put his feet into that basin of hot water first.

glosses.notes: 碰 can mean to hit something by accident, and it can also mean to touch something with your hand.

examples.sentence: 我走得太快，碰到了前面的车。
别碰那个杯子，里面的水很热。
这个杯子太薄，你轻轻一碰就会碎。

example_translations.translation: I was walking too fast and bumped into the car in front of me.
Do not touch that cup. The water inside is still very hot.
This cup is very thin. It will break if you touch it even lightly.

glosses.notes: 碰见 means meeting someone unexpectedly rather than as part of a plan.

examples.sentence: 我刚出地铁站，就碰见了以前的老师。
她在路上碰见妈妈，才知道家里来客人了。
我在超市里碰见同事，才想起今天要开会。

example_translations.translation: I had just come out of the subway station when I ran into one of my former teachers.
She ran into her mother on the road and only then learned that guests had come to the house.
I ran into a coworker in the supermarket and only then remembered we had a meeting today.

glosses.notes: This classifier is used for groups of goods or people handled as one batch or lot.

examples.sentence: 这批苹果今天早上刚从南方运到市场。
第一批游客已经上车了，大家再等十分钟。
老师说那批桌子明天上午送到学校。

example_translations.translation: This batch of apples was just shipped to the market from the south this morning.
The first batch of tourists has already boarded. Everyone else should wait another ten minutes.
The teacher said that lot of desks would be delivered to the school tomorrow morning.

glosses.notes: 批 can mean to criticize someone, mark written work, or sign off on a plan in a brief approving way.

examples.sentence: 因为我又迟到了，经理开会时当面批了我。
老师把我们的作业都批了。
领导已经把这个计划批了，我们明天就做。

example_translations.translation: Because I was late again, the manager criticized me to my face during the meeting.
The teacher has already marked all of our homework.
The supervisor has already approved this plan, so we will carry it out tomorrow.

glosses.notes: 批准 is the formal verb for giving permission or official approval.

examples.sentence: 经理批准了我的假，我下周可以回家。
这个项目昨天终于被学校批准了。
没有家长批准，孩子不能自己报名。

example_translations.translation: The manager approved my leave, so I can go home next week.
This project was finally approved by the school yesterday.
Without a parent's approval, a child cannot sign up alone.

glosses.notes: 匹 is the classifier used for horses, and it is also used for a bolt or length of cloth.

examples.sentence: 那匹老马看见主人来了，就慢慢走过来。
奶奶买了一匹蓝布，准备给我做裤子。
草地上那匹白马慢慢走到河边去了。

example_translations.translation: That old horse saw its owner coming and slowly walked over.
Grandma bought a bolt of blue cloth and plans to make me a pair of pants.
That white horse in the grass slowly walked over to the river.

glosses.notes: 骗 can mean deceiving someone to get something from them, or simply lying to them.

examples.sentence: 那个人假装是医生，差点骗走了老人的钱。
你别再骗孩子说打针一点儿也不疼。
他怕妈妈生气，就骗她说作业写完了。

example_translations.translation: That person pretended to be a doctor and nearly tricked the elderly man out of his money.
Do not keep telling children that shots do not hurt at all.
He was afraid his mother would get angry, so he lied and said he had already finished his homework.

glosses.notes: 拼 can mean putting things together, spelling out a word or name, or making one more all-out effort.

examples.sentence: 请把这两张小桌子拼在一起，大家才坐得下。
报名时我把自己的姓拼错了，只好重新填表。
比赛只剩最后一分钟，大家决定再拼一次。

example_translations.translation: Please push these two small tables together so everyone can fit.
When I signed up, I spelled my own surname wrong and had to fill out the form again.
With only the last minute left in the match, everyone decided to make one more all-out effort.
